reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Plant Ranger
reauth_confirm.description: The Plant Ranger integration needs to be reauthenticated.

application_credentials.description:
To use Plant Ranger, you need to register an OAuth application. Follow these steps:

1. Go to the [Plant Ranger Developer Dashboard]({developer_dashboard_url})
2. Create a new OAuth application
3. Set the redirect URI to:
   `{redirect_url}`
4. Copy the Client ID and Client Secret below
